Light 0.0.6 makes board media reliable and completes the missing board-management and recovery flows.

## Reliable board cards

- Image covers remain previewable when cards move between columns.
- Attachment previews now use shared, reference-counted object URLs, so one component can no longer revoke media that another component is still displaying.
- Concurrent requests for the same attachment are coalesced, and switching vaults cannot repopulate stale cached media.
- Board cards now resolve and save attachments relative to their own board document rather than whichever tab happens to be active.
- Cross-column moves preserve the complete card record, including cover, description, tags, checklist, note link, assignee, due date, and priority.

## Board management

- Every column has a visible actions menu with rename, add card, archive all, and delete actions.
- Right-clicking a column's blank area opens its column menu.
- Right-clicking the board background opens quick actions for adding a column or adding a card to a chosen column.
- Archived cards are now discoverable from the board toolbar, with a live count and the existing unarchive action available from each archived card.

## Related media fixes

- Applied the same safe attachment-lifetime handling to canvas images and editor attachments to prevent equivalent stale or revoked previews.

## Quality

- Added regression coverage for complete card preservation, shared attachment ownership, concurrent reads, and vault cache invalidation.
- Passed 1,062 automated frontend tests and the production PWA build before release.

## Downloads

- Windows x64 — NSIS installer
- Linux x64 — AppImage and Debian package
- macOS Apple Silicon — application bundle and DMG
- macOS Intel — application bundle and DMG

Installers are attached as each platform's build completes. The binaries are not code-signed yet; Windows and macOS may display a warning on first launch.
